description: Builds Airy-style crustal compensation from densities, then explains collision thrusts, flexure, erosion rebound and independent evidence for mountain roots.

related_resources.reason: Density compensation, mountain roots, erosion rebound and postglacial adjustment.
Observational constraints on crustal thickening and multiple Himalayan growth stages.
Divergent, convergent and transform boundaries, the Mid-Atlantic Ridge and San Andreas motion.

authorship.scope: Original Dynamic Earth surface processes and rock record lecture, companion, and source-linked metadata.

background: Geological processes and any calculations are introduced within the standalone narration.
